name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

aliases: what kind of monster is vulgara
faq.answer: Vulgara the Insatiable is a massive, winged vuldren terrorizing the Shen'dar Highlands. Deemed the scourge of the highlands by local authorities, her ravenous appetite and violent presence pose a severe danger to travelers and nearby settlements.
Constable Aonda of the local Peacekeepers issued the official bounty on Vulgara to protect local citizens, directing hunters to bring proof of the beast's death to Danarii Bellowveil.
faq.q: Who placed the bounty on Vulgara?

faq.answer: Vulgara is known to prowl a hilltop rise situated just southwest of Shen'dar Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where can Vulgara the Insatiable be found?

faq.answer: Danarii Bellowveil is the advisor handling the bounty's fulfillment. Strained by surrounding bandits and cultists, Danarii inspects Vulgara's severed head and dispenses the promised reward.
A vuldren is a dangerous, predatory winged beast found in the highlands. Vulgara is a particularly massive and vicious specimen whose insatiable predation threatens local settlements.
faq.q: What kind of creature is a vuldren?

aliases: what threats are in shendar highlands
faq.answer: Beyond predatory beasts like Vulgara, the Peacekeepers in the Shen'dar Highlands are stretched thin dealing with active threats from an entrenched cult and highland bandits preying on local citizens.
faq.q: What other threats plague the Shen'dar Highlands?

sections.body: A formal bounty posted by Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers marks Vulgara the Insatiable as an immediate danger to the highlands. The massive winged vuldren has terrorized travelers and local settlements from her roost southwest of Shen'dar Village, prompting local authorities to call on adventurous bounty hunters to bring her reign to an end.
sections.title: The Highland Scourge

sections.body: The Peacekeepers already find themselves besieged on multiple fronts, struggling to manage threats from regional bandits and a shadowy cult operating in the area. Eliminating Vulgara relieves critical pressure on the local populace, ensuring the skies over Shen'dar remain safe while defenders focus on civil defense.
sections.title: Pressured Protectors

summary: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable is a Peacekeeper bounty targeting a monstrous winged beast terrorizing the Shen'dar Highlands. Issued by Constable Aonda, the contract calls for adventurers to slay the ravenous vuldren and present her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
